typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	succuss_files as string[],
	last_update_time as string
}
source(output(
		FileName as string,
		Query as string,
		LastUpdateTime as string,
		Folder as string,
		Transformation as string,
		SalesforceObject as string,
		Header as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['export_metadata.csv']) ~> source1
source1 split(in($succuss_files, FileName),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(update, noUpdate)
ConditionalSplit1@update derive(LastUpdateTime = $last_update_time) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1, ConditionalSplit1@noUpdate union(byName: true)~> Union1
Union1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	input(
		{FileNamePrefix|CadenceExpected|ExpectedTime|EmailAlertsTo|SalesforceObject|Operation|PipelineName} as string
	),
	partitionFileNames:['export_metadata.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> UpdateMetadata
source1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('export_metadata_', replace(regexReplace($last_update_time, `[-:]`, ''), ' ', '_'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> ArchiveMetadata
